title: NTL Qwen LoRA
description: Two LoRA adapters (r=16, alpha 32, all attention/MLP projections) plus trained 18-class score heads for Qwen2.5-1.5B (base) as a sequence classifier. Qwen2.5-1.5B-lora-full/: one epoch on the Name That LLM open pool. Qwen2.5-1.5B-lora-mix/: lora-full continued on all of train.csv (x5) mixed with 20k pool rows. Merged by hand in latest_predict.py (no peft needed). Saved with peft 0.21.2.
